phrases.cure: Readers clock it as generated text and tune out of the words around it. Use a comma or a period, or restructure the sentence so it needs neither.

dashPunctuationInString.text: This string holds {{dash}} written as itself. <<cure>> If the dash is data, such as a test's input, write it as `{{escape}}`: the value stays the same, and the escape tells the next reader the dash is meant.

dashPunctuationInRawString.text: This raw string holds {{dash}}. <<cure>> If the dash is data, such as a test's input, move the text to an interpreted string and write it as `{{escape}}`, since a raw string cannot hold an escape and the escape tells the next reader the dash is meant.
